$comment: Cost-model inputs for deriving every real-time guardrail from the INR ceilings in config/environments/*.env. Per-SKU USD rates are NOT duplicated here -- src/tripplanner/validation/harness/pricing.py stays the single source for those. This file owns what pricing.py does not know: the USD->INR conversion, Google's account-wide free monthly allowances, how those pooled allowances split between environments, and the headroom used to size GCP quotas. Consumed by scripts/derive_limits.py and asserted by tests/test_limits_derivation.py.

fx.$comment: ALL ceilings and every persisted ledger amount are INR. USD appears only in provider pricing catalogs and is converted exactly once, at ledger ingestion, via cost_model.usd_to_inr(). Never compare a USD figure to an INR ceiling.

freePoolsPerMonth.$comment: Google Maps Platform free monthly allowances, pooled across EVERY project on the billing account rather than granted per project -- the three environments share one pool, so freePoolShare below must sum to <= 1.0.

freePoolShare.$comment: Share of each pooled allowance reserved per environment. Must sum to <= 1.0. Local takes the largest share because owner testing is the dominant consumer.

quotaSizing.$comment: GCP quota preferences are the real-time hard net beneath the INR ceiling. A daily quota is sized so one SKU alone cannot consume more than googleShareOfDailyCeiling of the daily INR ceiling, times dailyHeadroom. Per-MINUTE quotas are deliberately NOT cost-derived -- they exist to keep places_cache._pace() from tripping the provider circuit breaker, so they come from burstPerMinuteFloor instead.

anomaly.$comment: A trip is flagged when its INR cost exceeds BOTH ratioToMedian x the rolling median for its interaction kind AND absoluteFloorInr. The floor stops a quiet day with a tiny median from flagging every ordinary trip.

reservation.$comment: Reserve-then-reconcile. A turn reserves a pessimistic INR estimate at admission and reconciles to actual at completion, so concurrent turns cannot all pass a check each of them sees as unspent. Percentiles are computed over recent trips of the same interaction kind; seeds apply until minSamples trips exist.
